AOV is the governed metric kp:AverageOrderValue (Average Order Value: total sales divided by order count), bound to sales_performance.average_order_value. Restricting to calendar year 2023 — an absolute window, so no anchoring to max_date is needed; 2023 is fully inside the data coverage (2015-01-01 .. 2024-04-20) — I run: `run: sales_performance -> { aggregate: average_order_value; where: DT ? @2023 }` and report that single figure as the 2023 average order value.

No — customer lifetime value (CLV/LTV) is not a governed metric in the Knowledge Plane. It does not appear in the routing table under that label or as a variant, and the table lists every governed concept, so its absence is conclusive: there is no approved definition, binding or steward for it here. The closest governed things that exist are kp:AverageOrderValue (total sales / order count), kp:OrderCount, kp:TotalSales and kp:ActiveCustomer (a customer with at least one order in the last 2 years) — CLV could be built from those as an explicitly ungoverned/exploratory figure if you want one, but it would not be an official number. I've noted the gap for the stewards: appending to kp/agent/gap-log.md — `2026-07-30 | customer lifetime value | not governed; reported as a gap, no exploratory figure computed (user asked only whether it is in the KP)`.
